A properly drafted, registered mortgage deed protects both borrower and lender. We handle drafting, stamp duty and SRO registration end to end.

Key Takeaways

  • A mortgage deed is the legal document that creates a mortgage over a property as security for a loan.
  • A registered mortgage deed gives the clearest, strongest security and public record of the charge.
  • It requires correct drafting, stamp duty and registration at the Sub-Registrar Office.
  • Errors in the deed or valuation cause rejection and future disputes.
  • We handle drafting, duty and registration for borrowers and lenders.

When property is offered as security for a loan, a mortgage deed sets out the terms and creates the charge. A registered mortgage deed is the strongest form — it puts the security on the public record and protects both sides.

JaaGa drafts the mortgage deed, computes stamp duty, and handles registration at the SRO so the security is created cleanly and correctly.

When You Need a Mortgage Deed

When taking or granting a loan secured against a property and you want a properly registered mortgage.

When a lender requires a registered mortgage rather than a simple deposit of title deeds.

How We Handle It

  1. 1

    Draft the Deed

    Our advocates draft the mortgage deed with the correct parties, property schedule and terms.

  2. 2

    Stamp Duty & Fees

    We compute the applicable stamp duty and registration fee and arrange payment.

  3. 3

    Slot Booking

    We book the Sub-Registrar appointment for registration.

  4. 4

    Registration

    We coordinate registration and deliver the registered mortgage deed.

Documents Required

  • Property title deed
  • Loan / sanction details
  • Identity proof of parties
  • Property schedule and value
  • Prior EC (we can retrieve)

Common Problems We Solve

Existing charges

A prior mortgage changes priority. We check the EC/CERSAI first.

Valuation & duty

Wrong valuation invites penalties. We compute duty correctly.

Deed terms

Vague terms cause disputes. Our advocates draft precise clauses.

Why Mortgage Deed Matters

An improperly created mortgage can be challenged, mis-prioritised, or fail to give the security a lender expects. A correctly drafted, registered mortgage deed protects the loan and keeps the record clean for everyone.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is a mortgage deed?

The legal document creating a mortgage over a property as security for a loan, setting out the terms and the charge.

Why register it?

A registered mortgage deed gives the strongest, publicly-recorded security, clearer than an unregistered deposit of title deeds.

Do you check for existing mortgages?

Yes — we review the EC and CERSAI so priority and existing charges are known before registration.

Who pays the stamp duty?

Usually as agreed between the parties; we compute the correct amount either way.

Can NRIs execute one?

Yes, in person or via a valid Power of Attorney, which we guide.
